units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 44">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLIV</cite> ed. Bub. <he>פ׳ שפעלת שיצאו וכ׳</he> the work which thou didst accomplish, that they went forth from Egypt; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 746:1">Yalk. ib. 746</cite>.

Ned. 62ᵃ עשה דברים לשם פָּעֳלָם do things for the sake of their effect (for the good which is achieved through them (Treat. Der. Er. Zutta ch. II לשום פְּעוּלָּתָן); [Rashi: לשם פּוֹעֲלָם in the name of their Maker].
